name: Ghemme

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A red DOCG in the hills of Novara province, in Piedmont, from parts of Ghemme and Romagnano Sesia. It is made mainly from Nebbiolo, locally called Spanna, with Uva Rara and Vespolina allowed. It must age at least 34 months, 18 of them in wood.
